name: samurai
brief: Samurai warrior with jingasa. Sepia palette: yellow clothing, light skin, blue armor (chest, shoulders, forearms, leg plates, boots), blue jingasa covering half the face, orange accents.

plan.overall_look: Side-view samurai in a warm sepia palette. Light skin peeks at face lower half, neck, and hands. Yellow cloth layers (kimono sleeves, hakama) sit under rigid blue armor plates: do chest, sode shoulders, kote forearms, suneate shin plates, and blue boots. A wide conical blue jingasa overhangs the head and covers the upper half of the face (eyes may be partly hidden). Thin orange cord/trim accents on brim, belts, and plate edges.

upper_arm_far.visual_notes: Yellow sleeve under; blue sode shoulder plate covering upper arm with modest overhang; orange edge stitch.

lower_arm_far.visual_notes: Yellow sleeve cuff near elbow; blue kote forearm plate over lower_arm; light skin hand exposed (no glove fill on hand); orange cuff trim.

upper_leg_far.visual_notes: Yellow hakama cloth filling upper leg; optional small orange side cord.

lower_leg_far.visual_notes: Yellow cloth on shin under; blue suneate leg plate on shin; blue boot covering foot_far; orange plate/boot edge accents.

torso.visual_notes: Yellow kimono underlayer on torso mass; blue do (chest armor) plates over mid-chest with slight bulk overhang; orange belt/obi trim and plate edge lines. Light skin may show at neck opening if not covered.

head.visual_notes: Blue jingasa (same blue as armor) with wide conical brim overhanging past the skull on +X and top; bowl covers upper half of face so only lower face/chin/light skin shows below. Orange chin-cord or brim stitch accents. Do not paint over entire head — leave lower face transparent so light skin from base shows.

upper_arm_near.visual_notes: Yellow sleeve under; blue sode shoulder plate covering upper arm with modest overhang; orange edge stitch.

lower_arm_near.visual_notes: Yellow sleeve cuff near elbow; blue kote forearm plate over lower_arm; light skin hand exposed (no glove fill on hand); orange cuff trim.

upper_leg_near.visual_notes: Yellow hakama cloth filling upper leg; optional small orange side cord.

lower_leg_near.visual_notes: Yellow cloth on shin under; blue suneate leg plate on shin; blue boot covering foot_near; orange plate/boot edge accents.

user_facing_summary:
Outfit plan for `samurai`
Brief: Samurai warrior with jingasa. Sepia palette: yellow clothing, light skin, blue armor (chest, shoulders, forearms, leg plates, boots), blue jingasa covering half the face, orange accents.

Overall look:

Yellow cloth layers (kimono sleeves, hakama) sit under rigid blue armor plates: do chest, sode shoulders, kote forearms, suneate shin plates, and blue boots. A wide conical blue jingasa overhangs the head and covers the upper half of the face (eyes may be partly hidden). Thin orange cord/trim accents on brim, belts, and plate edges.

Design layers (same 10 names as base/layers/):
  - upper_arm_far: paint on [upper_arm_far] (pose parent=upper_arm_far) — Yellow sleeve under; blue sode shoulder plate covering upper arm with modest overhang; orange edge stitch.
  - lower_arm_far: paint on [lower_arm_far, hand_far] (pose parent=lower_arm_far) — Yellow sleeve cuff near elbow; blue kote forearm plate over lower_arm; light skin hand exposed (no glove fill on hand); orange cuff trim.
  - upper_leg_far: paint on [upper_leg_far] (pose parent=upper_leg_far) — Yellow hakama cloth filling upper leg; optional small orange side cord.
  - lower_leg_far: paint on [lower_leg_far, foot_far] (pose parent=lower_leg_far) — Yellow cloth on shin under; blue suneate leg plate on shin; blue boot covering foot_far; orange plate/boot edge accents.
  - torso: paint on [torso] (pose parent=torso) — Yellow kimono underlayer on torso mass; blue do (chest armor) plates over mid-chest with slight bulk overhang; orange belt/obi trim and plate edge lines. Light skin may show at neck opening if not covered.
  - head: paint on [head] (pose parent=head) — Blue jingasa (same blue as armor) with wide conical brim overhanging past the skull on +X and top; bowl covers upper half of face so only lower face/chin/light skin shows below. Orange chin-cord or brim stitch accents. Do not paint over entire head — leave lower face transparent so light skin from base shows.
  - upper_arm_near: paint on [upper_arm_near] (pose parent=upper_arm_near) — Yellow sleeve under; blue sode shoulder plate covering upper arm with modest overhang; orange edge stitch.
  - lower_arm_near: paint on [lower_arm_near, hand_near] (pose parent=lower_arm_near) — Yellow sleeve cuff near elbow; blue kote forearm plate over lower_arm; light skin hand exposed (no glove fill on hand); orange cuff trim.
  - upper_leg_near: paint on [upper_leg_near] (pose parent=upper_leg_near) — Yellow hakama cloth filling upper leg; optional small orange side cord.
  - lower_leg_near: paint on [lower_leg_near, foot_near] (pose parent=lower_leg_near) — Yellow cloth on shin under; blue suneate leg plate on shin; blue boot covering foot_near; orange plate/boot edge accents.

Painting rule: for each active export layer, prepare_outfit_slot_reference then paint ONLY via MCP tools onto design/layers/<layer>.png (fill_parts_on_slot for that layer's body_parts silhouette; fill_rect / draw_line / paint_pixels for details). FORBIDDEN: Shell/PIL scripts or external image generators. Each design file rigid-rotates 1:1 with its body part (no multi-parent split). Clothing MAY overhang the body silhouette — body underlay is alignment reference, not a clip mask; keep proportions sensible. If this matches, say OK and paint layers; otherwise revise the plan.
